A memcpy-parameter-overlap occurs in the XXH32 update path (XXH_memcpy / XXH_INLINE_XXH32_update called from PHP_XXH32Update in ext/hash/hash_xxhash.c / xxhash.h), causing memcpy to be invoked on overlapping source and destination ranges.
